performance.title: Performance Report
notes: Revenue trend ($M): Jan 14.9 · Feb 16.8 · Mar 19.9 · Apr 17.6 · May 15.8 — peaked in March, down two months running.
Orders hit a yearly high in May while gross fell — average order size is shrinking, worth watching.
